name: SN 2022oqm
basis: Spectroscopic supernova with a documented July onset and g/r rise. Selected independently of earlier project cohorts.

name: MGAB-V713
basis: The October replication established a 0.15-arcsec VSX match to this Z Cam-type dwarf nova. The historical control tests separated positive nights before 2025.

name: CRTS J222643.4-200536
basis: Cataloged RR Lyrae previously used as a period control. Its pulsation repeatedly crosses the reference level.

name: G 143-8 subtraction residual
basis: The star's Gaia trajectory, reference dates and image stamps identified a persistent negative residual at its old position. This tests whether pure negative detections are routed as repeatedly fading.
